# Oil change intervals

Astra J, 1.6 petrol, A16XER engine. Book says 20,000 miles or 1 year. Ignoring that, doing it every 8,000 miles or yearly, whichever first, because it's a lot of short trips to jobs and it uses a bit of oil.

## Spec

- Oil: 5W-30 fully synthetic, GM dexos2 approved. Been using Castrol Edge 5W-30 C3 or Mobil 1 ESP when on offer
- Capacity: 4.5 litres with filter. Buy a 5L can, the rest is for topping up
- Filter: cartridge type, Mann HU 712/11 x (comes with the O-rings)
- Sump plug: 14mm? no, it's a T45 Torx on this one. New sump plug washer every time. Torque 14 Nm, it's an aluminium sump, do NOT gorilla it
- Filter housing cap: 25 Nm, 32mm socket
- Uses about 0.5L per 2,000 miles between changes. Check dipstick every other fill-up

## Log

- 2023-02-11, 103,480 mi. Castrol Edge 5L £42 (Halfords). Mann filter £9.50. Did it on the drive with ramps. Old oil black but not sludgy
- 2023-09-30, 107,920 mi. Mobil 1 ESP 5L £39 on offer. Topped up 0.6L in between
- 2024-03-16, 111,850 mi. Done straight after the MOT retest. Castrol Edge again. Noticed filter housing cap O-ring a bit flat, glad I replace it every time
- 2024-10-05, 116,010 mi. Paid Stavros at Fishponds Autos to do it with the brake job, £75 incl oil and filter, invoice FA-2410-0388
- 2025-05-24, 120,640 mi. Did it myself. Mobil 1 ESP £44. Last one before selling
- (Astra sold Aug 2025, see [[Selling the old hatchback]])

## The bike

Honda CB125F: 10W-30, 0.9L (1.0L dry), every 2,500 miles. Done 2025-04-12 at 9,410 mi and 2025-09-20 at 11,900 mi. Drain plug 24 Nm. See [[Motorbike chain lube]] for the rest of the bike stuff.

## Disposal

Old oil goes in the empty 5L can, to Avonmouth recycling centre. Filters in a sealed bag in the same bay.
